@mapDetailsTitle.description: Heading of the persistent selected-object details panel.

@mapDetailsClose.description: Accessible close action; Escape also closes focused details.

mapDetailsOffscreen: This record is outside the current view. Its original details are retained.

@mapDetailsOffscreen.description: Camera movement retains the selected original snapshot; absence is not removal.

mapDetailsFilterExcluded: This record no longer matches the selected layers or filters. Its map highlight is cleared.

@mapDetailsFilterExcluded.description: Filter exclusion keeps original detail and explicitly clears the geographic highlight.

mapDetailsRemoved: This record is no longer available. Its details and map highlight are cleared.

@mapDetailsRemoved.description: Confirmed missing or no-longer-public selected record without implying an empty viewport.

mapDetailsWithdrawn: This record has been withdrawn. Its details and map highlight are cleared.

@mapDetailsWithdrawn.description: Explicit retraction removes public content and selection highlight.

mapDetailsInAggregate: The selected record belongs to the highlighted aggregate. These are its original details.

@mapDetailsInAggregate.description: Evidence-based aggregate linkage preserves the selected individual record.

@mapDetailsLoading.description: A snapshot-bound detail request is in progress.

mapDetailsError: Could not retrieve selected record details

@mapDetailsError.description: Safe detail request failure; raw errors are not displayed.

mapDetailsSnapshotExpired: The selected data snapshot has expired. Select a record from a refreshed map to request new details.

@mapDetailsSnapshotExpired.description: Expired detail snapshot retains original facts and never silently queries a newer publication.

@mapDetailFact.description: Typed fact label and value; null is explicitly unknown.

@mapDetailUnknown.description: Unknown nullable fact value; never a measured zero.

@mapDetailPlan.description: Explicit planned assertion label independent of colour.

mapDetailDirectionsUncalibrated: Directions A and B are source channels; geographic headings are not known.

@mapDetailDirectionsUncalibrated.description: Direction counters do not imply geographic movement or headings.

@mapDetailHourGranularity.description: Source measurement interval is hourly, never presented as minute data.

mapDetailSimplified: Simplified display geometry; the source location precision is retained.

@mapDetailSimplified.description: Geometry simplification does not improve or enlarge source precision.

@mapDetailAreaPrecision.description: Area precision must remain area-level when zooming in.

@mapDetailUnlocatedPrecision.description: No trustworthy drawable location is available.

@mapDetailRoleEventSite.description: Event-site role from the typed location contract.

@mapDetailRoleSensor.description: Sensor location role from the typed contract.

@mapDetailRoleAffectedExtent.description: Source-evidenced affected geography rather than a guessed site.

@mapDetailRoleAreaAssociation.description: Area association is not an exact event-site location.

@mapDetailRoleMention.description: A mentioned place is not an evidenced event location.

@mapDetailRoleUnknown.description: No reliable geographic role is supplied.

@mapDetailActive.description: Record active lifecycle or event status.

@mapDetailPlanned.description: Planned lifecycle or event status is not presented as active.

@mapDetailCancelled.description: Cancelled lifecycle or event status is explicit.

@mapDetailResolved.description: Resolved lifecycle or event status is explicit.

@mapDetailExtentRoad.description: Transport disruption affects an evidenced road segment.

@mapDetailLocationLocated.description: A sensor location is valid for the observation.

@mapDetailLocationUnlocated.description: A sensor lacks a reliable drawable location.

@mapDetailLocationAmbiguous.description: Ambiguous sensor location must not be guessed.

@mapDetailLocationInactive.description: Inactive sensor location does not establish observation coverage.

@mapDetailValueMissing.description: An indicator is missing rather than measured zero.

@mapDetailValueSuppressed.description: A statistical value is withheld and must not be inferred.

@mapUnlocatedTitle.description: Scoped unlocated-list heading, distinct from viewport results.

@mapUnlocatedClose.description: Accessible close action for the unlocated list.

@mapUnlocatedAreaScope.description: Shows the exact caller-approved area association identifiers.

@mapUnlocatedJurisdictionScope.description: Shows the exact approved source jurisdiction supplied by the caller.

mapUnlocatedScopeExplanation: These records have no usable map geometry. Association with this scope does not establish membership in the current map view.

@mapUnlocatedScopeExplanation.description: Unlocated facts never inherit guessed centroids or viewport membership.

mapUnlocatedSnapshotExpired: This list snapshot has expired. Restart the list to use a new snapshot.

@mapUnlocatedSnapshotExpired.description: Expired pagination cannot mix old and new publication pages.

@mapUnlocatedRestart.description: Explicitly clears the old page before creating a new list snapshot.

mapUnlocatedEmptyPage: No records returned on this page

@mapUnlocatedEmptyPage.description: Empty page only; does not claim verified absence or source coverage.

@mapUnlocatedNextPage.description: Replaces the current bounded page using its snapshot-bound cursor.
